# Silonka

> Buy authentic Ceylon Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) and premium spices from Sri Lanka. Ships to USA, UK & Europe.

For the full content index, see: https://www.silonka.co/llms-full.txt

Silonka is a premium direct-to-consumer spice brand specialising in single-origin Ceylon cinnamon, Ceylon black pepper, cloves, and cardamom sourced directly from smallholder farms in Sri Lanka. All products are hand-harvested, sun-dried, and processed in small batches. Silonka ships to the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe.

## Shop

- [Shop All Products](https://www.silonka.co/shop): Browse the full range of Ceylon spices available for purchase
- [Bulk Orders](https://www.silonka.co/bulk-order): Wholesale and bulk spice orders for restaurants, cafés, and businesses
